CURRENT_PROOF:
- MacBook networking is restored and SUPRA Drive bridge heartbeat is live.
- Desktop Commander cloud dashboard still shows existing device MacBook-Pro-de-Nicolas.local registered but OFFLINE.
- Existing remote device identity must be preserved.

DO NOW SEQUENTIALLY:
1) Inspect only the existing Desktop Commander Remote MCP client/service/process on this MacBook.
2) Resolve its exact installed executable, launchd/login-item/service registration, logs and last failure around the current session. No global rescan.
3) If the existing client is stopped, relaunch/restart that SAME existing client/service only. Do not create a new device and do not revoke/re-pair.
4) If launch-at-login is missing or disabled and the existing product supports it, restore the EXISTING launch mechanism only, without reinstalling.
5) Preserve SUPRA, bridge 18765, OpenCode 4096, Google Drive, Wi-Fi and all user data.
6) Verify the existing Desktop Commander remote process remains alive after restart and can reach its remote service.
7) Return the FIRST exact blocker if it cannot be restored without reinstall/re-pair.

RETURN EXACTLY:
STATUS=MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|FAIL_BOUNDED|TRUE_HUMAN_GATE
EXISTING_DEVICE_PRESERVED=YES|NO
CLIENT_EXEC=
CLIENT_PROCESS=
LAUNCH_MECHANISM=
